confidence.label: Usable
reasons: Packet-size spread meets DeltaQ/BBF targets (64-1444 B, ratio 22.56).

web.label: Web browsing
web.rationale: Web is latency-sensitive but should not collapse to zero from moderate throughput dips.

streaming.label: Video streaming
streaming.rationale: Streaming is throughput-dominant; latency/loss still matter but should not dominate.

calls.label: Video conferencing
calls.rationale: Calls are interaction-heavy; latency and loss lead, throughput is a secondary gate.

audio.label: Audio calls
audio.rationale: Audio calls tolerate lower bitrate but remain sensitive to latency/loss spikes.

backup.label: Online backup
backup.rationale: Backup is throughput-heavy; poor latency should not force near-zero QoO.

gaming.label: Real-time gaming
gaming.rationale: Gaming remains latency/loss first, but modest throughput shortfalls should not auto-zero.
